dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hmm... I like the way you've decorated this place. Very professional.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: This desk is big enough to have three books open at once. But that bookshelf is so tall...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Never mind, I can see a stool. I'll just climb on that.
